candidates.original_title: Altered prefrontal correlates of monetary anticipation and outcome in chronic pain
candidates.description: Whole-brain reward-related neural activity differs between fibromyalgia patients and healthy controls during monetary reward processing.
candidates.citation_sentence: These analyses were conducted to 1) confirm the ROI results in the present study, and 2) to examine the replicability of post-hoc whole-brain and expanded aMPFC results performed previously (Martucci et al., 2018).
candidates.notes: The whole-brain results showed group differences across reward-associated regions at an exploratory visualization threshold, and the authors characterize them as largely similar to the prior study, but do not provide a clear unqualified replication claim.
